description:
Use when a carrier asks whether to buy or lease their next tractor (or trailer), comparing full-service
lease (Ryder, Penske, NationaLease), capital lease, finance lease, walk-away open-end lease, or cash
purchase. Covers tax treatment, residual risk, maintenance bundling, balance-sheet impact, and
cash-flow modeling.
